content:
hannah: Quick FYI 1. Planning a short night-drop to publish 1.6.0-rc.0 for py/ts and mark the legacy sync client deprecated. Rolling in ~20m unless objections.
rory: 👍 fine from infra. what's the dist-tag so CI can pin?
gabi: suggest `ephemeral-rc-2026-03-21` to keep it distinct. I'll prep CHANGELOG and the `deprecated` field.
hannah: publish plan: 1) wheels -> testpypi 2) npm pack + publish with `--tag ephemeral-rc-2026-03-21` 3) run smoke + perf harness. Rollback: immediate yank on pypi/npm 403 or `signer-mismatch`. Runtime revert if 5xx > 0.5% or median latency +200ms in first 5m.
felix: noted. pin the monorepo `package.json` to "@redwood/sdk": "1.6.0-rc.0" for prow e2e.
deploy-bot: [483612-483613] publish job started: py(jb_48361) / npm(nb_48361) :rocket:
deploy-bot: [483613-483614] py -> testpypi SUCCESS (jb_48361) sha256: c0ffee...
hannah: starting npm publish now.
deploy-bot: [483614-483615] npm publish (nb_48361) FAILED: signer-mismatch detected uploading tarball. log: `signature verification failed for /tmp/pkg.tgz`
gabi: ugh, signer drift again. do we use fallback key? ops-bot, is manual approval required?
ops-bot: policy: key override requires one approver from security oncall.
felix: I can re-sign using archived key `key-2025-11` but need manual approval. gabi, can you ping security?
gabi: pinged @security-oncall for approval.
ops-bot: approval granted by @security-oncall. overriding key -> key-2025-11.
felix: re-signed and re-triggered publish.
deploy-bot: [483615-483616] npm publish (nb_48361) RESTARTED with key-2025-11 -> SUCCESS. dist-tag set -> ephemeral-rc-2026-03-21
hannah: running smoke suite against canary gateway. watching metrics closely.
deploy-bot: [483616-483617] smoke-suite started (is_48361)
rory: watching: first 3m stable, 0.07% 5xx, median latency +9ms. within rollback window.
hannah: marketing blurb request: short tech note with migration link and removal window (90d).
gabi: draft: "Developer preview: 1.6.0-rc.0 (ephemeral dist-tag `ephemeral-rc-2026-03-21`) available for partner testing. Legacy sync client `@redwood/sdk-sync` deprecated; migration guide: https://redwood.ai/migrate-sync. Scheduled removal: 90 days"
deploy-bot: [483617-4836129600] smoke-suite COMPLETE: PASS (is_48361). No further signer issues.
hannah: summary: RC published, signer fallback used with manual approval, smoke/pass. We'll keep tag 24h then either promote to `canary` or remove. Follow-ups: add pack checksum assertion and doc the key-override flow. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
